component.name: Lumina Engine
component.summary: A lightweight and versatile C++ game engine

description.p: Lumina Engine is a modern, lightweight, and high-performance game engine developed in C++. Designed with modularity and ease of use in mind, it provides a robust foundation for creating 2D games and interactive applications.
The engine offers a comprehensive suite of tools for developers, including:

ul.li: High-performance 2D rendering system optimized for speed and visual fidelity.
Integrated 2D physics engine for realistic collision detection and simulations.
Flexible scripting support allowing for rapid prototyping and game logic implementation.
Cross-platform architecture designed to run smoothly on modern Linux environments.
